The checklist items are about EL-level concerns (bloom computation, receipt processing, trie operations, RLP encoding, etc.) which are handled by the EL client (like geth), not the CL client (Prysm). Prysm only receives and passes through execution payloads from the EL via the Engine API.

All 25 items in this batch relate to EL-specific operations (bloom computation, cumulative gas validation, trie operations, RLP encoding, etc.) that are not implemented in Prysm — they're handled by the execution layer. Prysm merely stores these fields as opaque bytes in protobuf messages. This means all items should be classified as "out-of-scope" due to component mismatch (EL vs CL).

Let me verify this understanding by checking if Prysm has any trie or RLP implementation.
